builds.name: Menace of Abyss
builds.desc: An uncouth and very expensive optimised build that capitalises on his strangely high attack for a free unit. With the combination of Fury and Brash Assault, he almost always gets 4 attacks against melee opponents. The C skill can be safely exchanged with Savage Blow 3 for similar effect.
